meta.name: Midnight Pulp
meta.description:
Want to watch something strange?  Midnight Pulp is the place to find crazy action, hysterical horror, out-of-this-world sci-fi, offbeat docs, and much more!  Let your freak flag fly 24/7 on Midnight Pulp!

Shows: The Golden Fern, Airpocalypse, $100,000 Dollars For Lassiter, A Bullet for the General, Bad Man's River
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
